_provenance.paper: A. Airapetian et al. (HERMES Collaboration), 'First measurement of the tensor structure function b1 of the deuteron', Phys. Rev. Lett. 95 (2005) 242001, arXiv:hep-ex/0506018, DESY-05-077, INSPIRE 684394
_provenance.table: TABLE II, p. 5 of the arXiv PDF: 'Measured values (in 10^-2 units) of the tensor asymmetry A_zz^d and the tensor structure function b1^d. Both the corresponding statistical and systematic uncertainties are listed as well.'
_provenance.transcribed: 2026-09-23 from `pdftotext -layout` of the local copy; identical to the refs_dict entry hermes2005-b1-tensor (verified against the PDF 2026-09-16)
_provenance.licence: arXiv licence 'assumed-1991-2003' (http://arxiv.org/licenses/assumed-1991-2003/, checked 2026-09-23); only the six numeric rows are transcribed (facts), with attribution. No HEPData record exists for this paper.
_provenance.units: all A_zz and b1 columns in units of 1e-2; <x> dimensionless (Bjorken x on the NUCLEON mass); <Q2> in GeV^2
_provenance.extraction: Eq. (5): b1^d = -(3/2) A_zz^d F1^d, F1^d = (1 + Q^2/nu^2) F2^d / (2 x (1 + R)); F2^d = F2^p (1 + F2^n/F2^p)/2 with F2^p from ALLM97 [16] (hep-ph/9712415) and F2^n/F2^p from NMC [17] (Nucl. Phys. B 371 (1992) 3); R = R1990 [18] (Whitlow et al., PLB 250 (1990) 193).
_provenance.convention: PER NUCLEON: F2^d = (F2^p + F2^n)/2 is the average nucleon, so b1^d here is per nucleon (constants.hpp B1_PER_DEUTERON_TO_PER_NUCLEON block; phase_A_miller_normalisation.md). A_zz^d is a ratio and convention-free. Cartesian tensor polarization (A_zz, not T20).
_provenance.radiative_corrections: the asymmetries are Born-level: radiative background subtracted and unfolded with RADGEN (text p. 4); the comparison is to a Born structure function.
_provenance.correlated_normalisation: text p. 4: a normalisation uncertainty between injection modes of ~1e-3 in A_zz, CORRELATED over the bins, is part of the systematic column; this harness treats stat and syst as uncorrelated per bin (quadrature), which is the tolerance BENCHMARK_PLAN row 3 asks for, and says so.
